title: Lottery Conducted By The National Carbon Company

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35m-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. H-H-6
Date February 3, 1933.

Subject (in full) Lottery conducted by the National Carbon Company

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by Thos Robertson Supt.

The National Carbon Company (Yung Bei & Co.),
an American concern with offices at No.3 Canton Road,
have started a scheme, effective from February 1 until
April 30, whereby numbered coupons issued by the company
in exchange for the company's flashlight wrappers will
entitle the holders to participate in a draw for a number
of prizes. The scheme has been evolved by Mr. V. Desborough,
sales manager, and its object is undoubtedly that of
stimulating the sale of goods.

According to Mr. Bryan, Municipal Advocate, the
fact that no payment is made by the entrant is immaterial,
no skill is necessary in order to obtain a prize, and this
alone constitutes a lottery under American Law. Mr. Bryan
referred the matter to Mr. G. Sellett, Attorney to the
U.S. Consul, and the latter confirmed Mr. Bryan's opinion
but added that it is a case which he, personally, would
not take exception to.

An innovation of this description is not a lottery
under Chinese Law, inasmuch as the promoters are not assured
of a definite percentage of the proceeds. Primarily,
the object of the National Carbon Company is to increase
the sale of flashlight batteries among the Chinese,
and in all probability the latter named will be the only
persons to whom the lottery will appeal. Various Chinese
enterprises have recently conducted similar schemes with
the same object in view, and if foreign firms were to be
denied this privilege it would tend to create unfair
competition, a factor which in western countries the law
assists in eliminating.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 1，特别科
报告
档案号 H-H-6
日期 1933年2月3日。

主题（全称） 国家碳素公司举办的彩票活动

由 D.S. Sansom 撰写 经总监 Thos Robertson 转呈

国家碳素公司（永备洋行），
一家美国商号，办公地点位于广东路3号，
已启动一项计划，自2月1日起至
4月30日止，根据该计划，该公司以手电筒包装纸换取的编号优惠券，
将使持有者有资格参与抽奖，赢取若干奖品。该计划由销售经理 V. Desborough 先生策划，
其目的无疑是为了刺激商品销售。

据市检察官 Bryan 先生称，
参与者无需支付费用这一事实无关紧要，
获奖无需任何技巧，仅凭这一点，
根据美国法律即构成彩票。Bryan 先生
将此事项转交美国领事馆律师 G. Sellett 先生，
后者确认了 Bryan 先生的意见，但补充说，就他个人而言，
对此并无异议。

此类创新根据中国法律并不构成彩票，因为发起方
并不能确保从收益中获得固定的百分比。首先，
国家碳素公司的主要目的是增加手电筒电池在中国人中的销量，
极有可能只有上述人群才会对该彩票感兴趣。近期，多家中国企业
出于相同目的开展了类似计划，如果外国商行
被剥夺此项特权，则将导致不公平竞争，而在西方国家，
法律有助于消除这种因素。

February 1, 1933. Morning Translation

POLITICAL.

The Russo-Japanese Situation.

After the Japanese occupation of Manchuria,
it was thought that Russia would enter into conflict with
Japan, but Russia is now assuming a patient attitude.
Further changes in the situation depends upon the following
points:-
1. To what extent the Japanese will invade China.
2. To what degree Russia will keep patient.
3. To what degree Soviet interests have been encroached
upon by Japan.

The American-Soviet Rapprochement.

The alleged American-Soviet Rapprochement is
liable to be realized during the present grave situation.
The American authorities have shewn dissatisfaction with the
Japanese military action. America is now assuming an
attitude similar to that of Soviet Russia.

Anglo-Japanese Secret Agreement.

It is reported that England concluded a secret
agreement with Japan during the truce of the local Sino-
Japanese hostilities. Whether this is true or not cannot
be ascertained at present.

Dr. Wu will proceed to Nanking to day to
attend the conference to be held soon to discuss the drafting
of regulations governing the convention of the People's
Assembly.

MISCELLANEOUS. PRIZE TO ASSIST THE SALE OF GOODS.

The Yung Pei & Company (an American concern),
No. 3 Canton Road, publishes a large advertisement in the
Sin Wan Pao announcing that upon receipt of the upper part
of a paper wrapper used by the concern for its flashlight
battery, bearing the name and address of the purchaser, it
will between February 1 and April 30, give the purchaser a
numbered coupon entitling him to participate in winning one
of the following prizes:-
1st Prize: One diamond finger ring value $1,000
2nd Prize; One diamond finger ring value $500
3rd Prize: One 7-tube radio receiver value $250
4th Prize: One wrist watch value $100
5th Prize: One gold watch value $50
Ten other prizes value $10 each.
The drawing will take place under the supervision of three prominent merchants at the beginning of May next.
The venue of the drawing and the date will be announced later.

1933年2月1日。晨间译报

政治类。

日俄局势。

日本占领满洲后，人们曾认为俄国将与日本发生冲突，但俄国目前正采取忍耐态度。局势的进一步变化取决于以下几点：-
1. 日本侵入中国的程度。
2. 俄国保持忍耐的程度。
3. 苏联利益受日本侵犯的程度。

美苏缓和关系。

所谓的美苏缓和关系在当前严峻的局势下有可能实现。美国当局已对日本的军事行动表示不满。美国目前正采取与苏维埃俄国相似的态度。

英日秘密协定。

据报，在中日局部敌对行动停战期间，英国与日本缔结了一项秘密协定。此事真伪目前尚无法查明。

吴博士将于今日前往南京，出席即将召开的会议，讨论起草关于国民大会公约的规章。

杂项。促销奖品。

永备公司（一家美国商号），位于广东路3号，在《新闻报》上刊登大幅广告，宣布凡收到该公司用于其手电筒电池的包装纸上半部分，并印有购买者姓名和地址者，将在2月1日至4月30日期间，向购买者发放一张编号优惠券，使其有资格参与抽取以下奖品之一：-
一等奖：钻戒一枚，价值1,000美元
二等奖：钻戒一枚，价值500美元
三等奖：七管收音机一台，价值250美元
四等奖：腕表一只，价值100美元
五等奖：金表一只，价值50美元
其他十个奖品，各值10美元。
抽奖将于明年五月初在三位知名商人的监督下进行。
抽奖地点及日期将另行公布。
